cms_ownership_interpretation: CMS continues to identify the exact CCN and facility as a Government - Federal acute-care hospital. This ownership field is retained as current evidence; it does not negate the separately evidenced Cherokee Nation operation under an IHS self-governance compact.
ihs_transfer_observation: IHS states that transfer of its Claremore Indian Hospital to the Cherokee Nation was effective October 1, 2025, in the context of the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act.
current_operator_observation: The current Cherokee Nation page names the Claremore Outpatient & Emergency Health Center at the former hospital site; describes the service scope including emergency, outpatient and other clinical services; and records that Cherokee Nation Health Services assumed operations on October 1, 2025. The page was observed in the connected browser during this review and is updated August 23, 2026.
cherokee_report_observation: The Nation's FY2025 audited comprehensive financial report subsequent-events note states: Claremore Indian Hospital operations were assumed effective October 1, 2025 under the self-governance compact with HHS/IHS, funded through the IHS compact annual funding agreement.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program as defined by section 4(12) of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act to be in compliance with Part 180.
statutory_definition_observation: 25 USC 1603(12) includes tribal health programs in the Indian Health Program definition; 25 USC 1603(25) defines a tribal health program as a tribe/tribal organization operating a health program or facility funded through an IHS contract or compact under ISDEAA.
prior_pointer_observations: Retained separately in reconciliation-claremore-ownership-transition-proof-2026-09-23.json and reconciliation-claremore-ownership-transition-recheck-proof-2026-09-27.json. This scope determination does not convert their IHS root-pointer timeouts into evidence of non-publication.
interpretation: Current exact-CCN CMS information retains the historic federal ownership field and facility identity. IHS and the Cherokee Nation's audited report independently establish that Cherokee Nation assumed operation of this same hospital under an IHS self-governance compact with annual compact funding, and the current operator page identifies continuing Claremore clinical operations. The Indian Health Program scope category is supported under 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2), read with 25 USC 1603(12) and (25). This is a scope classification only: it makes no MRF-availability, pointer-linkage, file-quality, or facility-closure claim.
next_action: Retain the exact-CCN CMS ownership/identity response and the current operator/compact evidence. Revisit only if CMS CCN identity, facility operation, operator, or compact status changes. Keep historic IHS pointer timeouts as transport observations, not publication findings.
